summary: The response acknowledges the Foothills Trail Conference's potential sign program but clarifies that the applicant (Duke Power) would bear primary responsibility for ensuring the program's adequacy pursuant to its commitments in Exhibit R.
text: Although the Foothills Trail Conference may undertake a sign program, the Applicant would assume primary responsibility to ensure the adequacy of the program pursuant to its commitments in Exhibit R.

closing_anchor: to ensure the adequacy of the program pursuant to its commitments in Exhibit R.
